X93 RelWide le (64-bit array): becomes lt
old: case BO_LE: REL_LOOP(0, LD(py, base + j), a <= b, LD) break; \
new: case BO_LE: REL_LOOP(0, LD(py, base + j), a < b, LD) break; \

name: X94 RelWide ge (64-bit, integer): becomes gt
old: default:    REL_LOOP(0, w, a >= b, LD) break; \
new: default:    REL_LOOP(0, w, a > b, LD) break; \

name: X96 RelWide ne (64-bit, integer): becomes eq
old: case BO_NE: REL_LOOP(0, w, a != b, LD) break; \
new: case BO_NE: REL_LOOP(0, w, a == b, LD) break; \

name: X100 RelSwap: lt not swapped
X101 RelSwap: ge not swapped
X102 RelValue: integer-first operator not swapped
X103 RelValue: the integer taken from the wrong side
old: x != NULL ? RelWide(d, op, x, y, wy)
new: x != NULL ? RelWide(d, op, x, y, wx)
